t: Maintain docs/llm-full.txt and README.md as living closeout artifacts — update both every session
dogfood_gaps_fixed: typecheck clarified as git diff only
description: README.md frozen at session 15 (v2.0.19, 321 lines). docs/llm-full.txt does not exist. Both are critical user-facing artifacts. README.md is what users read first. llm-full.txt is the single-file LLM context loader — load it and any AI has full framework knowledge without reading every file. This task: (1) initial update pass to bring both current, (2) adds Step 7b to closeout protocol so they stay current forever.
perceive: 1. Read README.md at /home/mario/projects/wheelwright/framework/README.md — 321 lines, stale since session 15. Note stale sections: version refs, architecture diagram, skill list, feature list. 2. Confirm docs/llm-full.txt does not exist at /home/mario/projects/wheelwright/framework/docs/llm-full.txt. 3. Read templates/commands/wai.md (wakeup protocol), templates/commands/wai-closeout.md (closeout protocol), templates/commands/wai-lug-schema.md (lug schema and gb field). 4. List templates/commands/*.md — authoritative skill list: SKILL-EXAMPLES.md, wai-benchmark.md, wai-chat-to-track.md, wai-closeout.md, wai-complexity-gate.md, wai-context-guard.md, wai-foundation-gate.md, wai-foundation.md, wai-green-light.md, wai-ide-setup.md, wai-improve.md, wai-init-v2.md, wai-lug-schema.md, wai-mode.md, wai-principles.md, wai-red-light.md, wai-rules.md, wai-shipit.md, wai-signal-capture.md, wai-status.md, wai-stewardship-guard.md, wai-stewardship-framework.md, wai-sync-v2.md, wai-time.md, wai-track-generate.md, wai.md. 5. execute: PART A — README.md rewrite (replace in place, not new file): Include these sections in order: (1) Title + one-liner from WAI-State.json identity. (2) Architecture diagram — ASCII showing Framework repo → Hub project → Spoke project, each with WAI-Spoke/ subfolder containing WAI-State.json/WAI-Lugs.jsonl/sessions/seed/ingest. (3) Skills section — list all templates/commands/*.md files with one-line description each. (4) Lugs section — explain JSONL format, PEV fields (perceive=what to read, execute=what to do, verify=how to confirm done), gb field = actual model ID like claude-sonnet-4-6 NOT self-chosen names, impact scale 1-10. (5) Hub-spoke fleet section — hub-registry.json discovery, hub-spoke-registry.yaml skill, delivery map. (6) Track encapsulation + historian section — per-turn point capture, historian advisor, taste files. (7) Quick start — clone framework, set hub_path in spoke WAI-State.json, run /wai at session start. (8) Live spoke examples — PathFinder (/home/mario/projects/pathfinder, v0.4.0, 18 sessions, AI-powered career placement) and Tracks (/home/mario/projects/wheelwright/tracks, v0.1.0, 0 sessions, progress tracking). (9) License. Keep under 400 lines total. || PART B — Create docs/llm-full.txt: docs/ directory exists. Create docs/llm-full.txt with this structure: Header block (lines starting with #) explaining: 'This file is a single-file LLM context loader for the Wheelwright Framework. Load it into your context to understand the full protocol without reading individual files. Generated from source — do not edit manually, regenerate via Step 7b of wai-closeout.' Then concatenate in order, each preceded by delimiter line '=== FILE: {relative-path} ===': (1) WAI-Spoke/WAI-State.json, (2) templates/commands/wai.md, (3) templates/commands/wai-closeout.md, (4) templates/commands/wai-lug-schema.md, (5) all other templates/commands/*.md alphabetically, (6) framework/skills/track-encapsulation.yaml, framework/skills/historian.yaml, framework/skills/hub-spoke-registry.yaml, framework/skills/hub-registry-refresh.yaml, framework/skills/teaching-test-bench.yaml, (7) CHANGELOG.md top 20 entries only. Check total file size — target under 200KB (~50K tokens). If over, drop the lowest-priority docs/ files first. || PART C — Insert Step 7b into templates/commands/wai-closeout.md after line 201 ('### 7. Documentation Updates' section): Add new subsection '### 7b. Docs Sync (Mandatory When Protocol Changed)' with content: 'After any session that modifies skills, protocol files, or architecture: (1) Update README.md — at minimum update the version ref (wheel.version from WAI-State.json). If skills were added/removed, update the skill list. If architecture changed, update the diagram. (2) Regenerate docs/llm-full.txt — concatenate source files per the structure in lug 43c7023a0244. A script at docs/regenerate-llm-full.sh can automate this. (3) If no protocol changes this session: note Skip 7b: no protocol changes in session summary. This step is skippable but must be explicitly noted if skipped.'
verify: 1. cat WAI-Spoke/WAI-State.json | python3 -c "import json,sys; v=json.load(sys.stdin)['wheel']['version']; print(v)" — confirm version string appears verbatim in README.md. 2. ls templates/commands/*.md | xargs -I{} basename {} — confirm each filename appears in README.md skill list. 3. grep '=== FILE: templates/commands/wai.md ===' docs/llm-full.txt — must match. 4. grep '=== FILE: templates/commands/wai-closeout.md ===' docs/llm-full.txt — must match. 5. grep '=== FILE: templates/commands/wai-lug-schema.md ===' docs/llm-full.txt — must match. 6. head -10 docs/llm-full.txt — first lines must be the header comment explaining purpose and how to load it. 7. grep '7b' templates/commands/wai-closeout.md — must match. 8. git diff --stat | grep -E 'README.md|docs/llm-full.txt' — both must appear. 9. wc -c docs/llm-full.txt — must be under 200000 bytes.
